---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: 'enhancement'
assignees: ''

---

## Description
A clear and concise description of what the feature is.

## Problem Statement
Is your feature request related to a problem? Describe it here.
(e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Be as detailed as possible.

## Alternative Solutions
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases
What would users be able to do with this feature? Who would benefit?

## Design / Mockup
If applicable, attach a sketch, wireframe, or mockup of what this feature might look like.

## Related Issues
Link to any related issues (e.g., #123, #456).

## Additional Context
Any other context, links, or examples that would be helpful.
